generator: tools/blender/build_isu_blocks.py for the 26-block geometry; Blender MCP material study and glTF export in output/blender-mcp-20260927
material: The official Blender Lab MCP server controlled Blender 5.2.1 to compare acrylic, glass, full-transmission, and balanced blue materials on the existing ISU geometry. The selected balanced Principled BSDF uses official ISU Blue and Green base colors, blue transmission 0.60, roughness 0.11, IOR 1.46, coat 0.50, and subtle subsurface scattering in the Blender study. The GLB carries KHR_materials_transmission, KHR_materials_ior, and KHR_materials_clearcoat; glTF does not carry Blender subsurface scattering. The browser scene applies water-scene-specific absorption and restrained reflections.
attributes: position, normal, uv (shared atlas, uv.smart_project + uv.pack_islands), color (R=AO, G=edge wear, B=per-block tint)
note: Block shapes are generated procedurally by the script. No models, textures or code from third-party sites are included.
decoder: apps/web/public/draco/* copied from three 0.183.2 examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf (MIT via three)

textures.isu-blocks-normal.webp: Tangent-space, OpenGL (+Y) normal map baked (Cycles, selected_to_active) from a per-block high-resolution sculpt (VOXEL_HI remesh + procedural fine frost grain and directional frost streaks, seeded from the block index) onto the shared low-poly UV atlas. Desktop 2048x2048 quality 90, apps/web/public/models/mobile/ copy scaled to 1024. No external assets.
textures.isu-blocks-detail.webp: R=detail ambient occlusion baked with a 0.25 world light distance including neighbor-block and floor contact shadow (floored at 0.3 to match the vertex AO floor); G=convexity baked from the Geometry node's Pointiness output remapped to 0..1; B=0. Desktop 2048x2048 quality 85, mobile copy scaled to 1024. Generated procedurally by the same script, no external assets.
